pairwise_interactions.title: The Wolverine Stack: Dual Microvascular & Actin Remodeling Synergy
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: BPC-157 acts locally by accelerating microvascular angiogenesis via VEGFR2 and stabilizing granulation tissue, while TB-500 sequesters G-actin to drive rapid systemic cell migration and prevent fibrous adhesion/scar formation.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: In-vitro assay titration protocol. BPC-157: 250–500 mcg equivalent reference. TB-500: 2.0–2.5 mg equivalent reference standard. Aliquot with separate sterile micro-volume laboratory instruments.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Strictly maintain separate sterile syringes. Do NOT combine dry lyophilized cakes or mix solutions into a single vial.
pairwise_interactions.citation: PubMed: 21030672 (Sikiric P, et al.) & 20119825 (Philp D, et al.)

stackedProtocol.eveningDose: Optional second BPC-157 dose if acute tissue injury
stackedProtocol.weeklySchedule: TB-500: 2.5 mg on Monday and Thursday (or 5.0 mg once weekly). BPC-157: Daily (Mon-Sun).
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Two separate sterile U-100 syringes. Never mix in one barrel.

pairwise_interactions.title: The Somatotropic Pulse Stack: Complementary GHRH + GHRP Synergy
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: CJC-1295 (GHRH agonist) stimulates the synthesis and transcription of Growth Hormone in pituitary somatotropes, while Ipamorelin (selective GHSR agonist) suppresses somatostatin and triggers the vesicular release pulse. Together they produce an amplified physiological GH pulse up to 5x higher than either alone.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Co-administer together 30 minutes before sleep on a strictly fasted stomach (≥2 hours after last meal) to avoid somatostatin release from carbohydrate/insulin spikes.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Prepare each compound in its own vial. Assays should be performed with separate analytical aliquots to avoid cross-contamination.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Eur J Endocrinol (2006) / J Endocrinol Invest (2000)

stackedProtocol.morningDose: Optional fasted morning dose: CJC-1295 100 mcg + Ipamorelin 200 mcg
stackedProtocol.eveningDose: Primary dose 30 min before bed: CJC-1295 100 mcg + Ipamorelin 200 mcg (≥2h fasted)
stackedProtocol.weeklySchedule: 5 days on, 2 days off (e.g., Monday through Friday on, weekends off) to preserve pituitary receptor sensitivity.
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Separate sterile syringes for each vial. Inject in contralateral abdomen.

pairwise_interactions.title: Metabolic Dual-Action Stack: Incretin Satiety + Beta-3 Adipocyte Lipolysis
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Tirzepatide centrally suppresses appetite, improves glycemic control, and downregulates hepatic de novo lipogenesis via GLP-1/GIP. AOD-9604 acts peripherally on adipocyte beta-3 adrenergic receptors to trigger active lipolysis and fat breakdown without interfering with blood glucose or insulin sensitivity.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Tirzepatide: 1x weekly SubQ. AOD-9604: 300–500 mcg daily SubQ in the morning in a fasted state prior to light cardio.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Completely non-overlapping mechanisms. Monitor hydration and electrolyte balance.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Int J Obes (2001) & N Engl J Med (SURMOUNT-1)

stackedProtocol.morningDose: AOD-9604: 300–500 mcg SubQ every morning upon waking (fasted)
stackedProtocol.weeklySchedule: Tirzepatide: 2.5–5.0 mg once weekly on Sunday evening. AOD-9604: Daily morning.
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Tirzepatide weekly syringe + AOD-9604 daily U-100 syringe.

pairwise_interactions.title: Neuro-Regenerative BDNF & Anxiolytic Balance Stack
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Semax drives robust neurogenesis, memory consolidation, and executive focus by upregulating BDNF and TrkB receptors. Selank prevents overstimulation by modulating GABA-A receptors and preserving endogenous enkephalins, creating calm, laser-sharp focus without anxiety or jitters.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Semax: Morning administration (intranasal or SubQ). Selank: Midday or during acute stress/anxiety episodes.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Avoid taking late in the evening as Semax neurotrophic activation may disrupt circadian sleep architecture.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Dokl Biol Sci / Ross Fiziol Zh Im I M Sechenova

stackedProtocol.morningDose: Semax: 200–400 mcg SubQ or intranasal (Morning focus window)
stackedProtocol.eveningDose: Selank: 250 mcg SubQ or intranasal (Late afternoon to balance cortisol)
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Keep individual vials/sprayers separate. Never mix solutions.

pairwise_interactions.title: Melanocortin Photo-Protection & Central Libido Stack
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Melanotan II provides systemic melanin upregulation via MC1R/MC4R, while PT-141 (Bremelanotide) selectively acts centrally on hypothalamic MC4R to trigger rapid erectile and sexual arousal pathways without cardiovascular vasoconstriction.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Melanotan II: low-dose daily or 3x weekly pre-bed. PT-141: acute administration 45–60 min prior to target activity.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Monitor solution stability during laboratory testing; store reconstituted aliquots strictly at 2°C–8°C.
pairwise_interactions.citation: J Sex Med / Int J Impot Res

stackedProtocol.eveningDose: Melanotan II: 250 mcg pre-bed. PT-141: 1.0–1.75 mg as needed (max 2x weekly).

pairwise_interactions.title: Mitochondrial Bioenergetics & Telomeric Longevity Stack
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Epithalon stimulates telomerase reverse transcriptase (TERT) to preserve chromosomal telomere length and circadian rhythm, while NAD+ directly fuels mitochondrial ATP synthesis and activates Sirtuin enzymes (SIRT1/SIRT3) for cellular DNA repair.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: NAD+: Morning SubQ or slow IM. Epithalon: Evening pre-bed SubQ for a 10–20 day cycle twice per year.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Inject NAD+ slowly over 60 seconds to prevent transient chest tightness or flushing.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Biogerontology (Anisimov VN, et al.) & Cell Metab

stackedProtocol.morningDose: NAD+: 50–100 mg SubQ / IM (slow push upon waking)
stackedProtocol.eveningDose: Epithalon: 5–10 mg SubQ pre-bed (10 consecutive days)
stackedProtocol.weeklySchedule: Epithalon: Daily for 10-20 days. NAD+: 2-3x weekly ongoing.
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: NAD+ requires slow injection; Epithalon in separate fine 31G needle.

pairwise_interactions.title: Microvascular & Extracellular Matrix Remodeling Synergy
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: BPC-157 rapidly generates fresh capillary networks (angiogenesis) to deliver oxygen and amino acids to damaged tissue, while GHK-Cu signals fibroblasts to synthesize new type I/III collagen and elastin while inhibiting TGF-beta scar formation.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Administer in separate SubQ injections daily. BPC-157 morning, GHK-Cu evening, or staggered by at least 2 hours.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Do NOT combine concentrated copper peptide with acidic peptide solutions in the same syringe.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Oxid Med Cell Longev / J Biomater Sci

stackedProtocol.eveningDose: GHK-Cu: 1.5–2.5 mg SubQ (deep subcutaneous or rotate into glute)
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Strictly separate syringes. Copper chelate has deep blue color; do not mix.

pairwise_interactions.title: Incretin GI Tolerance & Mucosal Cytoprotection Stack
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: GLP-1 receptor agonists can cause transient delayed gastric emptying, nausea, and mucosal irritation. BPC-157 provides direct cytoprotective benefits across gastric epithelium, reducing gut discomfort while incretins drive metabolic weight loss.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Tirzepatide: Weekly SubQ. BPC-157: 250–500 mcg daily SubQ or stable oral arginate.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Administer BPC-157 on empty stomach for maximum gastric cytoprotection.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Curr Pharm Des / Gut

stackedProtocol.eveningDose: BPC-157: 250 mcg evening fasted (especially on days 1-3 after Tirzepatide injection)
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Separate syringes; inject into alternate abdominal quadrants.

pairwise_interactions.title: GLP-1 Gut Barrier & Epithelial Recovery Stack
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Semaglutide delays gastric motility to enhance satiety. BPC-157 upregulates tight junction proteins (Claudin, Zonula Occludens) and nitric oxide synthesis, minimizing digestive cramping and acid reflux in GLP-1 naive subjects.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Semaglutide: Weekly SubQ. BPC-157: 250–500 mcg daily.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Rotate injection sites; maintain hydration.
pairwise_interactions.citation: World J Gastroenterol

pairwise_interactions.title: Cellular Redox & Mitochondrial Energy Shield
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: NAD+ replenishes the mitochondrial electron transport chain, generating minor reactive oxygen species (ROS) during oxidative phosphorylation. Glutathione acts as the master intracellular ROS scavenger, converting hydrogen peroxide to water and preserving mitochondrial membrane potential.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Administer NAD+ morning and Glutathione either morning or midday.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Inject both in separate sites; Glutathione is viscous and benefits from 27G-30G needle.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Antioxid Redox Signal

stackedProtocol.morningDose: NAD+: 50–100 mg SubQ + Glutathione: 100–200 mg SubQ
stackedProtocol.weeklySchedule: 2 to 3 times per week (e.g., Monday, Wednesday, Friday).
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Two separate syringes. Never combine in one vial.

pairwise_interactions.title: Contraindicated: Redundant Incretin Receptor Overload
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Both compounds are long-acting incretin receptor agonists competing for the exact same GLP-1 receptor sites. Stacking them together produces severe redundant receptor saturation without additive therapeutic weight loss.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: DO NOT STACK CONCURRENTLY. Complete a mandatory 3-to-4 week washout period when transitioning between incretins.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Severe risk of compounded gastrointestinal adverse reactions (gastroparesis, intense nausea, dehydration, pancreatitis risk).
pairwise_interactions.citation: Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol / SURPASS & STEP Clinical Trials

pairwise_interactions.title: Contraindicated: Dual GLP-1 Receptor Competitive Saturation
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Semaglutide and Tirzepatide both potently activate the GLP-1 receptor. Running both simultaneously floods the receptor bed, causing receptor downregulation and acute gastrointestinal distress with no incremental fat loss.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: DO NOT STACK CONCURRENTLY. Maintain a 3-week washout before switching agents.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Excessive delay in gastric emptying, profound hypoglycemia risk if combined with secretagogues, and severe nausea.
pairwise_interactions.citation: N Engl J Med / SURPASS Trials

pairwise_interactions.title: Contraindicated: Redundant Multi-Incretin Agonism
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Retatrutide already contains full GLP-1 and GIP agonism (plus Glucagon). Stacking Tirzepatide adds duplicate GLP-1 and GIP molecules, creating extreme receptor competition.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Select ONE multi-incretin compound. Do not co-administer.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: High risk of rapid dehydration, gastrointestinal paralysis, and severe vomiting.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Lancet / TRIUMPH Phase 2 Trial

pairwise_interactions.title: Redundant & Unfavorable: Dual Non-Selective GH Secretagogues
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Both peptides act directly on the pituitary GHS-R1a receptor. Stacking two non-selective secretagogues causes competitive receptor saturation while drastically compounding adverse elevations in systemic cortisol and prolactin.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Choose ONE selective secretagogue (such as Ipamorelin) instead of stacking multiple first-generation GHRPs.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: High risk of water retention, prolactin-induced gynecomastia, and cortisol-driven gluconeogenesis.
pairwise_interactions.citation: J Clin Endocrinol Metab (1998)

pairwise_interactions.title: The CagriSema Protocol: Coordinated Amylin + GLP-1 Incretin Synergy
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Cagrilintide engages area postrema and ventral tegmental amylin receptors while Semaglutide stimulates hypothalamic GLP-1 receptors, producing multiplicative appetite suppression and glycemic control superior to either monotherapy.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Co-administered once weekly on the same day. Titrate gradually every 4 weeks.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Strict stepwise escalation required to prevent gastrointestinal adverse events.
pairwise_interactions.citation: PubMed PMID: 37385280 (Lancet 2023)

stackedProtocol.morningDose: Weekly SubQ administration (0.5 mg to 2.4 mg combined)
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Separate sterile syringes unless utilizing validated co-formulated CagriSema standard.

pairwise_interactions.title: The Anabolic Saturation Stack: Satellite Cell Proliferation + Myofiber Differentiation
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: PEG-MGF drives rapid proliferation of dormant muscle satellite cells into an expanded stem cell pool, while IGF-1 LR3 triggers differentiation of those newly created cells into mature, functional myofibrils.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: PEG-MGF: 200–400 mcg 2–3x weekly post-workout. IGF-1 LR3: 20–50 mcg daily on training days.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Consume 30–50g fast-acting carbohydrates with IGF-1 LR3 to prevent transient hypoglycemia.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Biochem Biophys Res Commun / J Appl Physiol

stackedProtocol.morningDose: IGF-1 LR3: 25 mcg SubQ post-training with nutrition
stackedProtocol.eveningDose: PEG-MGF: 200 mcg SubQ on post-training days
stackedProtocol.weeklySchedule: IGF-1 LR3 on training days (Mon/Wed/Fri); PEG-MGF post-workout.
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Separate sterile U-100 syringes. Never combine in one vial.

pairwise_interactions.title: Enhanced Wolverine Stack: Acid-Stable Angiogenesis + Systemic Actin Remodeling
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Stable L-arginate salt of BPC-157 ensures robust microvascular VEGFR2 capillary ingrowth and gut barrier recovery, perfectly paired with TB-500 systemic G-actin sequestration for organized scar-free tissue repair.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: BPC-157 Arginate: 250–500 mcg daily (SubQ or oral). TB-500: 2.5 mg twice weekly SubQ.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Sterile technique for TB-500; BPC-157 Arginate may be administered orally or SubQ.

stackedProtocol.weeklySchedule: BPC-157 Arg: Daily (Mon-Sun). TB-500: 2.5 mg on Monday and Thursday.

pairwise_interactions.title: Visceral Lipolysis & Clean Pulse Stack: GHRH Selective Transcription + GHRP Release
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Tesamorelin selectively targets visceral abdominal fat while stimulating pituitary GH transcription; Ipamorelin triggers vesicular release without elevating prolactin or cortisol.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Co-administer together 30 minutes before sleep on a strictly fasted stomach (>=2 hours after last meal).
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Pre-bed administration strictly fasted to avoid somatostatin release from carbohydrate/insulin spikes.
pairwise_interactions.citation: N Engl J Med / J Clin Endocrinol Metab

stackedProtocol.eveningDose: Tesamorelin 1.0 mg + Ipamorelin 200 mcg SubQ (>=2h fasted)
stackedProtocol.weeklySchedule: 5 days on, 2 days off (Monday through Friday on, weekends off).
stackedProtocol.syringeHandling: Separate sterile syringes for each vial.

pairwise_interactions.title: Cardiovascular Bioregulation Stack: Endothelial Nitric Oxide + Myocardial Protection
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Vesugen restores microvascular endothelial capillary elasticity and blood flow, while Cardiogen protects cardiomyocytes from ischemic strain and suppresses pathological collagen scar fibrosis.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Administer both compounds during morning hours in 10-20 day research cohorts.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Endogenous bioregulator tri/tetrapeptides with exceptional safety profiles.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Bull Exp Biol Med / Adv Gerontol

pairwise_interactions.title: Comprehensive Myostatin & Activin Neutralization Protocol
pairwise_interactions.mechanismSummary: Follistatin-344 directly binds circulating myostatin while ACE-031 acts as a soluble ActRIIB decoy receptor, suppressing both myostatin and activin signaling to maximize lean tissue retention.
pairwise_interactions.timingProtocol: Conservative micro-dosing in short 10-20 day experimental blocks.
pairwise_interactions.safetyRule: Monitor connective tissue adaptation as muscle force generation rises rapidly.
pairwise_interactions.citation: Mol Ther / Muscle Nerve

stackedProtocol.weeklySchedule: Follistatin daily for 10-20 days; ACE-031 weekly.
